senses.gloss: (b. h. pl. גַּרְגְּרוֹת neck; גרגר; v. גָּרַר, throat, gullet; (in ritual law) wind-pipe, trachea.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:6:1">Koh. R. to XII, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00885"><he>גָּלָה</he></cite> Hif.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 24">Ex. R. s. 24</cite> the Lord created for man <he>מעין בתוך גַּרְגַּרְתּוֹ</he> a well (mucous membranes) in the trachea.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:4">Ḥull. II, 4</cite> <he>פסק את הג׳</he> he tore open (instead of cutting) the trachea.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:3">Ib. III, 3</cite> <he>פסוקת הג׳</he> an animal with a split between the rings of the wind-pipe.
